messages:
sophia (CSM): Quick check-in on VEGAcorp hosted API spend vs commit — our weekly monitor flagged a 38% overshoot vs their monthly commit. Saw surge starting Thu evening. @matt can you pull any recent support tickets or config changes?

billing-bot: Automated alert: VEGAcorp | hosted | spend delta = +38% vs committed run rate | current burn: $12,450/day | projected month burn: $373k | commit: $270k | anomaly_score: 0.87

matt (account-ops): I see a large batch ingestion from VEGA's staging org at 22:40 UTC on Thu. Entries marked as 'unknown client' in request logs. Opening infra ticket #7832.

liam (eng): Confirmed — a scheduled smoke test to validate a model switch accidentally used prod keys. Rolling back keys and blocking the offending IP range now. Patch deployed 03:10 UTC.

sophia (CSM): Nice catch. Do we need to propose a one-time credit and tighten quotas for tomorrow's rollout?

matt (account-ops): Recommend: 1) Apply temporary usage cap to VEGA at 60% above baseline; 2) Issue one-off credit equal to overage above commit for this billing period pending postmortem; 3) Schedule 30m touch with product lead. @legal if this needs review.

liam (eng): Also adding a safeguard: require an explicit `env` header on all client tokens to avoid staging->prod key mixups. I'll open a PR and add a runtime guard.

sophia (CSM): I'll draft the credit proposal and ask for signoff. Can someone paste the exact overage numbers? Need to send to VEGA PM by EOD.

billing-bot: Overage calc: overage_amount = $103,000 | days affected = 3 | avg daily overage = $34,333

matt (account-ops): Sending proposed email now. cc: @legal. Next steps: postmortem + action items in #incidents if root cause confirmed.

sophia (CSM): Thanks all. Scheduling follow-up 10:30am PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:

liam (eng): PR filed: redwood/infra#4527 — enforce `env` header + blocklist rule. ETA review 4h.

sophia (CSM): I'll capture notes for renewal risk — flagging as 'medium' until we conclude. Please add any customer-facing collateral that might help reassure them.

matt (account-ops): Agree. Updating CRM with risk tag and note about one-off credit pending postmortem.
